litellm_route.registration_notes: model registration = model_list entry with model_name (client-facing id) + litellm_params.model (openai/<upstream-id> for OpenAI-compatible custom endpoint) + api_base + api_key via os.environ indirection; drop_params strips unsupported OpenAI params so tools/tool_choice pass cleanly
litellm_route.simple_tag_membership: bielik appears in a SIMPLE routing tag list alongside nvidia/gpt-oss-20b, greenpt/gpt-oss-120b, or/gpt-oss-20b-free
litellm_route.restart_flow: edit tmpl -> python3 scripts/render-litellm-config.py -> direnv exec . docker compose -f compose.nexgate.yaml restart litellm

backend_serving.current_backend: coopforge-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint (NEXGATE_COOPFORGE_BIELIK_API_BASE env), reached as openai/bielik-minitron-7b through LiteLLM; exact serving engine behind coopforge (vLLM vs other) unverified [uncertain]

vllm_flags.tool_call_parser: --tool-call-parser hermes for Hermes-format tool calls; also llama3_json, mistral, pythonic, llama4_pythonic, glm47, hf (checkpoint response_template), beam; parser must match the model's trained tool-call format
vllm_flags.chat_template: --chat-template optional; hermes/mistral/llama ship tool-compatible templates in tokenizer_config.json; can pass 'tool_use' to select a tool-use template
vllm_flags.strictness: VLLM_ENFORCE_STRICT_TOOL_CALLING (default true) + --tool-strict-level auto|function|parameter; per-tool strict: true pins argument schema under auto tool choice; parser default floor is 'function' for glm47, 'auto' for others

backend_serving.ollama: native tools param in Ollama API + OpenAI-compat /v1 endpoint supports tools (since 2024-07 Llama 3.1 launch); tool responses via role:tool messages; no parser flags — format baked into engine
backend_serving.llama_cpp: OpenAI-compatible server; tool support via grammar-constrained JSON; weakest of the three for agentic loops
backend_serving.recommendation: For Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0-Instruct swap: serve on vLLM with --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser hermes (Bielik v3 Instruct uses Hermes-style tool format per outline), context 32k; or Ollama if tools tag confirmed for the GGUF

model_registration: omp-side registration of this gateway: see omp_models_yml_providers.json (provider nexgate, baseUrl http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1, api openai-completions, apiKey env)
flags_and_budget: gateway-side knobs: per-deployment max_tokens 8192, timeout/num_retries (60s/2 typical, 1800s/1 for slow GPU backends, 0 retries for paid job APIs); router stream_timeout 1800
tool_calling_support: declared via model_info.supports_function_calling/supports_tool_choice/supports_parallel_function_calling = true on both bielik routes; drop_params ensures tools param survives mismatched backends
context_and_limits: bielik: context_window 16384; coopforge/bielik-minitron-7b: context_window 32768, max_tokens 8192; quantization/VRAM backend-side [uncertain]
tool_call_rate: curl gate through this gateway: 20/20 valid (100%) with 1 tool; suite via omp: 33%/16% — see Tool_calling_transport.json
streaming_behavior: stream=True supported end-to-end; router stream_timeout 1800s; REPEATED_STREAMING_CHUNK_LIMIT 100 default guards model loops; details in Tool_calling_transport.json
reasoning_core_gate: orthogonal to gateway routing; gate runs in omp extension process — see omp_models_yml_providers.json and outline item 'reasoning-core gate (omp)'
pass_criteria: gateway-level gate: curl pre-flight >=90% tool-call validity (measured 100%); suite >=80% is harness-level — see Tool_calling_transport.json
